summary: Executed 9 backend regression tests and mobile preview checks for auth, pincode discovery, VIP unlock, reviews, owner reply, availability, and instant reservation.

critical.issue: Review replies and admin review listing do not authenticate or authorize the caller; any unauthenticated client can modify reviews or access moderation data.

Instant booking endpoint accepts arbitrary customer identity and marks payment_status PAID without authentication or payment verification; this is explicitly MOCKED sandbox behavior but must not be treated as production payment authorization.

minor.issue: Direct pytest invocation fails at collection unless EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is exported; the test file does not load frontend/.env. With the configured variable supplied, all tests pass.

action_items: Require authenticated admin/owner authorization for review listing and owner replies.
Require authenticated customer ownership checks for booking creation and replace MOCKED PAID status with verified Cashfree payment in production.
Make regression tests load the configured frontend env or document/export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend Expo web preview initially logged a transient missing react-native-svg bundle error, but subsequent bundling succeeded and the rendered app had no visible errors.
Interactive mobile pincode search and hall navigation worked; all tested controls had stable testIDs.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed users, memberships, review, owner reply, and instant booking records through regression tests; no seeded records were modified except the test review reply.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview https://campus-halls.preview.emergentagent.com and local web preview both loaded. Auth payload token/session_token matched on login, demo-login, and register.
rca_of_issue: Authorization is absent in server.py for get_admin_reviews and reply_to_review, while booking creation hardcodes payment_status=PAID. Add role-aware auth dependencies and a real payment verification boundary before production use. Cashfree checkout is MOCKED/simulated in this environment.
